status: found by reproducing the order in the build session; each is a question for the reviewer — none is resolved by the build

findings.title: A negative supply working capital is admitted, and its negative interest netted against the wheeling interest (West DISCOM: −94.19, −11.77)
findings.detail: West DISCOM's supply working capital is negative — its consumer security deposits (2,767.08) and a month of power purchase (1,470.65) exceed two months' receivables and the inventory — and Table 61 admits interest of −11.77 on it, netted against the wheeling interest of 20.60 to 8.82.  Regulation 38 as the order quotes it makes the interest 'payable on normative basis'; it does not say whether a negative requirement yields a negative allowance or nil.  UPERC's practice on NPCL's FY2026-27 working capital was nil against a surplus (increment 111).  For the reviewer: which reading MPERC's Regulations support.
where: MPERC order on the MP DISCOMs FY2026-27, p.107 Table 61; pp.105–106 (Regs. 23, 38 as quoted)

findings.title: The inventory's GFA base is not printed: 21.07 implies 15,802.50 for East, against Table 57's opening GFA of 9,576.28
findings.detail: Para 2.228: 'one percent of opening Gross Fixed Asset has been pro-rated to two months … divided into wheeling and retail inventory in the ratio of 80:20'.  East's wheeling inventory 21.07 is 1 % × GFA × 2/12 × 80 % only for a GFA near 15,802.50 (West 12.76 → 9,570; Central 20.11 → 15,082.50).  Table 57's opening GFA for FY2026-27 is net of consumer contributions and grants (9,576.28; 5,381.83; 10,900.30), and gives smaller inventories.  The base is presumably the gross GFA; the order does not print it.  The 80:20 split itself holds on every DISCOM.  The inventory enters the binding as a record.
where: MPERC order on the MP DISCOMs FY2026-27, p.106 para 2.228; p.107 Table 61; p.99 Table 57

findings.title: Table 65's FY2025-26 row 'Equity addition admitted' prints East's and Central's proposed equity (226.34, 197.31); the opening equity of FY2026-27 carries the lower 30 % (181.25, 177.85)
findings.detail: Para 2.241 (c) admits the lower of 30 % of the net addition and the proposed equity, and 2.242 says East and Central claimed the proposed instead of the lower.  For FY2025-26, Table 65's row labelled 'Equity addition admitted during the Year' prints 226.34 (East) and 197.31 (Central) — above 30 % of their net additions (181.25, 177.85) — yet the opening equity of 1 April 2026 is 1,768.44 + 181.25 = 1,949.69 and 2,123.29 + 177.85 = 2,301.14, and Table 59's loan additions (422.91, 414.98) are the net additions less the same lower figures.  The row therefore prints the proposed equity under the 'admitted' label; the computation uses the admitted.  West's (129.20, below its 30 %) is the same either way.  The FY2026-27 rows are consistent.
where: MPERC order on the MP DISCOMs FY2026-27, pp.111–112 Table 65; p.104 Table 59; para 2.241–2.242
